I told Hollis in a thread on his question in #central-team that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47.

Pree first said Dock 23 in that channel on Oct 14, then corrected it the same day to Gate 47 because she had read the wrong line. My reply tells Hollis that Dock 23 is out of date, so he doesn't put it on the account sheet.
